expected_artifacts.description: A svchost.exe process started with a suspicious command line
A DLL file accessed by a legitimate process
A connection to a C2 server

biocs.name: Phantom DLL Loading Behavior
biocs.description: Detection of a legitimate process accessing a suspicious DLL file path
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'svchost.exe'
| filter action_file_path contains 'inject.dll'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name = 'svchost.exe'
